one_liner: PitchBook has a REST API (PB-Token API key) but access is a paid, contract-gated Direct Data add-on via account manager; sandbox key only after engaging sales.
auth_notes: Static key sent as 'Authorization: PB-Token {API_KEY}'. No OAuth for the REST API (OAuth only on the vendor's hosted MCP server). Credits are also required per call.
access_notes: API keys are provisioned by the Direct Data team / account manager after a separate contract; no self-serve signup or trial. Sandbox key must be requested from the account manager. API credits must be purchased.
blocker_notes: Credentials only via a sales/contract conversation with PitchBook's Direct Data team, plus purchased API credits. Docs are on Postman but keys are not self-serve.

evidence.quote: include a header named "Authorization" with the value of "PB-Token {API_KEY}" with each API request.
PitchBook authenticates with a static API key sent on every request, so there is no OAuth flow.
Access to the PitchBook API is a paid, contract-gated add-on and is not available via a self-serve dashboard.
There’s no developer signup page. There’s no “generate an API key” button in the dashboard. You can’t start testing without a sales conversation first.
Please reach out to your account manager to request a sandbox key.
The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser.
The PitchBook remote MCP server is a hosted Model Context Protocol endpoint at https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp
PitchBook Data MCP gives investment teams native, secure access to a subset of PitchBook’s dataset, including company, deal, investor, and fund data
